# Acosta Matos / RIC / hotel-investment poster and perimeter-map continuity — 1 September 2026

**Status:** repository-only continuity and correction record. This record does **not** publish or replace a rendered website route and does not itself establish any criminal, tax, ownership or causation conclusion.

## Purpose

This record preserves the visual and analytical direction developed in the originating ChatGPT thread so it is reconstructable after chat deletion. It controls the **next corrected poster/infographic**, the 2017–2026 hotel/investment map, and its non-hotel investment/development supplement.

The visual direction remains a high-contrast public-interest **spoof advertisement** using black/yellow/white/red, organised around:

1. Sun Park / MYND Yaiza as the historical anchor;
2. the later hotel, RICPE, Canarian Hospitality, MYND, Sholeo, Radisson/franchise and investment network;
3. a capital/incentive “flywheel” to be **tested by tracing**, not assumed; and
4. a final panel headed **Questions, not conclusions**.

## Mandatory correction rules for the next poster

1. **No approximate names.** Resolve legal persons through CAEPR/canonical controls; preserve hotel names, trading names, legal owners, operators, brands, managers, financiers and builders as separate objects.
2. `Mind Hotels` → **MYND Hotels**.
3. `Canary Hospitality` → **Canarian Hospitality, S.L.** where the legal company is intended.
4. **Radisson is a brand/franchise edge**, not an owner label. A Radisson-branded hotel is not Acosta-owned merely because Canarian manages it or Acosta built/refurbished it.
5. **Sholeo Lodges** is a Canarian Hospitality brand. The user-literal `Solano` remains unresolved; Sholeo is only a possible intended candidate and must not be silently substituted.
6. Exact BORME denomination: **ACOSTA MATOS INVESTMENTS, SOCIEDAD LIMITADA**, plural `INVESTMENTS`, sheet GC 61953. The Acosta website source-literal `Acosta Matos Investment, S.L.` may be preserved only as a quoted/source literal until the source-to-entity bridge is displayed.
7. Do not collapse **Construcciones Acosta Matos, S.A.** into the five 2023 demerger beneficiaries: Grupo Acosta Matos, S.L.; Promociones Acosta Matos, S.L.; Construcciones Acosta Matos, S.L.; Grupo Patrimonial Acosta Matos, S.L.; Hotel Callao Adeje, S.L.
8. Preserve the repository distinction between **RIC (Reserva para Inversiones en Canarias)** and **RIC Private Equity Investment Partners / RICPE**.
9. **Investor, subscriber, taxpayer and RIC materialiser are not automatic synonyms.** The poster may ask who bore economic risk, subscribed, obtained a tax benefit, introduced capital or received fees, but it must not state that a lawful RIC participant is “not an investor” solely because the investment has tax consequences.
10. `tax avoidance/evasion`, `fraud`, `criminal scheme`, `fruit of the forbidden tree` or equivalent language is never converted into an adjudicated fact by graphic design. Where used, it must remain attributed allegation, investigative hypothesis, metaphor or question, with the lawful alternative explanation preserved.
11. Current website marketing/promotion inventory is not land-registry title and is not silently backdated into the 2017–2026 acquisition chronology.
12. Board membership/governance is not silently converted into share ownership. This rule controls the 2026 **Socios Inversores Canarios, S.L.** node as well as hotel SPVs.

## Controlling fifth question

The additional bottom-panel question is preserved as:

> **WHO WERE THE “INVESTORS” — INDEPENDENT CAPITAL, RIC TAXPAYERS/SUBSCRIBERS, INTRODUCED CLIENTS, RELATED PARTIES, OR INTERMEDIARIES?**

Sub-questions: who bore economic risk; who received the RIC/tax benefit; who subscribed; who introduced whom; who was paid for introduction/placement/structuring; what conflicts or abstentions applied; and where subscribed, borrowed, public-supported or internally transferred money ultimately went.

## Unitary reverse-engineering hypothesis — proof boundary

The project-side hypothesis to test is whether Sun Park was used, from the pre-reopening / 2017–2018 period onward, not merely as a hotel asset but as a platform of asset/control credibility, promotional material, investor access, RIC materialisation, refinancing, operating income and transaction momentum from which later economic benefits or further acquisitions could have been generated.

Required sequence:

`Sun Park access/control/title state` → `project/investor representation` → `RICPE/other financing` → `works / HNT / MYND` → `cash/equity/debt/guarantee/fee flows` → `later assets/projects`.

For each downstream node test: acquisition consideration; equity subscriber; lender; RICPE/other financing; intercompany balances; guarantees/collateral; construction margin; management/brand fees; public incentives/aid; refinancing; distributions; sale/exit proceeds; and any documented recycling into later projects. **Chronology, board overlap, family relation, website grouping or group affiliation alone is not tracing.**

`Fruit of the forbidden tree` may remain only as a rhetorical investigative metaphor. The evidential question is whether a later asset/benefit is financially traceable to a **proved** unlawful antecedent. No chain is presumed.

## Material corrections from the 1-Sep-2026 scan

### Radisson Blu Lanzarote

Do **not** depict as Acosta-owned on present evidence. Public/RICPE material identifies **Las Coronas de Teguise, S.L.** as owner/project company, Canarian Hospitality as manager, Radisson as brand and RICPE as financier. Public reporting identifies an Al-Bochi ownership/investor lane. Acosta may be shown separately where works/rehabilitation are sourced.

### Sholeo Lodges Los Gigantes

Do **not** depict as presently proved Acosta-owned. Public project material identifies **Oceánica Hotel Management, S.L.** as property/acquisition vehicle and Canarian as manager. BORME establishes a historical perimeter connection: Laura Patricia Acosta Matos was sole administrator before Oceánica lost unipersonality on 30-Nov-2022; she ceased and Aeromédica Canaria, S.L. became sole administrator. Current shareholding is open.

### Radisson Resort & Residences Tenerife / former Parque San Antonio

Asset company: **Tenerife Assets Company, S.L.** Public reporting describes the 25-Jul-2024 acquisition from HIP by a group of Canary investors. Canarian manages; Acosta undertook architecture/construction/renovation. BORME proves **Grupo Patrimonial Acosta Matos, S.L.** served on the board/as secretary before the April-2025 governance change. Exact Acosta equity is open. RICPE financing is recorded, but **related-party/conflict classification is not asserted unless the specific RICPE/CNMV record proves it**.

### Acosta Matos Investments

BORME: incorporated 30-Nov-2023; sole shareholder at incorporation Construcciones Acosta Matos, S.A.; sole administrator Laura Patricia Acosta Matos; sheet GC 61953. A Jan-2024 capital increase brought subscribed capital to **€10.633m**. Priority tracing node for Sholeo Maspalomas and any other assigned asset.

### Hotel New Trend / MYND Yaiza

Acosta’s project page identifies Hotel New Trend, S.L. as MYND Yaiza owner. BORME records the earlier CAM→HNT Sun Park tourist-unit segregation and in June 2024 identifies **Grupo Patrimonial Acosta Matos, S.L. as HNT sole shareholder**. Use this legal-person bridge instead of generic “Acosta Matos ownership”.

## Chronology to retain

- **2017–2018:** Sun Park / LPB debt, property, minority/control and commercialisation period already reconstructed elsewhere; do not assume 2018 is the start if earlier evidence exists.
- **2019:** RICPE registered; dated Acosta/RICPE governance relationships remain source-specific.
- **2020–2021:** AC Tenerife and MYND Adeje financing/development; broader RICPE relationship/investor-process period.
- **2022:** MYND Yaiza/HNT and Radisson Blu Lanzarote RICPE financing; Sun Park tourist-unit segregation into HNT; hotel-opening period.
- **2023:** Sholeo Los Gigantes; CAM total demerger; Acosta Matos Investments incorporation.
- **2024:** Las Palmas Sholeo flats; Tenerife Assets/former Parque San Antonio investor-group acquisition; Sholeo Maspalomas/RICPE; HNT sole-shareholder bridge to Grupo Patrimonial.
- **2025:** Sholeo Maspalomas; MYND Marieta roadmap reference; Radisson Tenerife reopening/financing path.
- **2026:** 97-suite five-star Playa Blanca project announced as Grupo Acosta Matos + Canary investors, Canarian management and planned Radisson relationship; south-Fuerteventura/Jandía pipeline remains a future/open-SPV node; **Socios Inversores Canarios, S.L.** becomes a separate multi-company investment/governance discovery node with downstream portfolio still open as of the control date.
